parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that it is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

parameters.name: CustomPrivacyPolicyContents
parameters.description: The details of the custom privacy policy content.

parameters.name: CustomPrivacyPolicyName
parameters.description: The name of the custom privacy policy.

parameters.name: DefaultLanguageCode
parameters.description: The default language of the privacy policy.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the custom privacy policy.

parameters.name: UserConsentType
parameters.description: The consent type for the privacy policy.
